parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: the per-year holiday cache was removed, so holidays() calls the holiday source on every is_business_day check, causing repeated file reads and parses with JsonHolidaySource during day-walking functions like add_business_days and business_days_between. Differences are only in wording and examples (overdue() vs roll_forward/ticket queue), not in the underlying failure.
